purpose: UI to tracking-runtime IPC correctness and resilience

cases.userFriction: The dashboard should open quickly even when the tracker was already running.

cases.scenario: Tracker restarts while UI is open
cases.userFriction: A tracker restart should look like a recoverable status change, not an alarming app failure.

cases.scenario: UI restarts while tracker remains running
cases.userFriction: Closing the dashboard must not stop or reset tracking.
Version mismatch should explain that an update is required rather than appearing as random loss of tracking.
A bad UI/client must never be able to destabilize the background tracker.
Security failures should not produce confusing desktop prompts or require user intervention when silently rejectable.
A frozen dashboard must never slow or stop the tracking engine.

cases.scenario: Large analytics request incorrectly sent over IPC
cases.userFriction: Opening a large history must remain responsive and should not make the tracker appear busy.
